en: A black‑and‑white landscape view over a wooded valley toward a European town. In the foreground are steep‑roofed half‑timber houses partly hidden by trees. In the middle distance stands a large monastery‑ or palace‑like complex on a hill with many small dormer windows. To the right is a prominent Baroque-style church with a tall tower and onion-shaped spire. Forested hills surround the settlement, giving a misty, romantic atmosphere typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
